finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If an attacker can control the 'url' or 'wordlist_path' arguments, they could inject malicious content that gets executed as a command.
finding.assumptions: The 'url' argument is used to construct the HTTP request and the 'wordlist_path' is used to open the file containing the paths to test. If the 'url' argument is not properly validated or sanitized, it could lead to OS command injection.

finding.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
finding.trigger: If the server's response contains user-supplied data that is not properly sanitized, it could lead to XSS.
finding.assumptions: The server's response is printed directly to the console without any sanitization. If the response contains user-supplied data, it could be used to inject malicious scripts.
